title: Identification of novel anti-inflammatory Nur77 modulators by virtual screening.
authors: Ding, Xiaoyu; Zhao, Zijie; Wu, Yue; Zhang, Hao; Chen, Kaixian; Luo, Cheng; Luo, Xiaomin; Xu, Heng
one_liner_zh: 该文通过虚拟筛选发现Nur77小分子调节剂，聚焦核受体-配体互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI/物理模拟方法用于TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联度低。
abstract: Orphan nuclear receptor Nur77 is a unique member of the NR4A nuclear receptor subfamily, which is critical for cellular processes especially the inflammatory responses. Many efforts have been made to discover novel scaffold small molecules targeting Nur77. Herein, we evaluated the previously reported binding sites in crystal structures of Nur77 with small molecules, and then discovered compound 13 as a hit of Nur77 via virtual screening targeting the best-scored binding site. Based on the results of fluorescence titration assay, structure-activity relationship (SAR) analysis was summarized for compound 13 and its analogs. Among these analogs, compound 13e displayed the most potent binding affinity (0.54 +/- 0.02 muM). The binding mode of compound 13e was predicted via molecule docking. Moreover, 13e exhibited significant anti-inflammation activity in TNF-alpha induced HepG2 cell model. Taken together, these results provided a new insight into the understanding the functions of specific binding sites on Nur77 for small molecular compounds, and the development of new scaffold Nur77 modulators.
abstract_zh: 孤儿核受体Nur77是NR4A核受体亚家族中的独特成员，对细胞过程尤其是炎症反应至关重要。为发现靶向Nur77的新型骨架小分子，已进行了大量努力。在此，我们评估了先前报道的Nur77与小分子共晶结构中的结合位点，并通过针对最佳评分结合位点的虚拟筛选，发现化合物13作为Nur77的命中物。基于荧光滴定实验的结果，总结了化合物13及其类似物的构效关系（SAR）分析。在这些类似物中，化合物13e显示出最强的结合亲和力（0.54 ± 0.02 μM）。通过分子对接预测了化合物13e的结合模式。此外，13e在TNF-α诱导的HepG2细胞模型中表现出显著的抗炎活性。综上所述，这些结果为理解Nur77上特定结合位点对小分子化合物的功能提供了新见解，并促进了新型骨架Nur77调节剂的开发。
